caption: A balloon rubbed on a wool jumper is lowered over small torn scraps of paper on a table, and the scraps jump up and cling to the balloon.

sa.check: A balloon is rubbed on a wool jumper.
Small torn scraps of paper lie on a table.
The balloon is lowered over the scraps.
The scraps jump up and cling to the balloon.
The scraps are small: torn pieces, not whole sheets.
The rub comes first, then the lowering, then the jump.

pc.expect: The scraps lie still until the balloon is close above them, then leap up to it; scraps far from the balloon stay put.
pc.fail: Scraps jump while the balloon is still high above or off to one side; or scraps across the table stir while the balloon is far from them; or the scraps move before the balloon has been rubbed and brought near; or scraps slide away from the balloon.

pc.expect: Scraps that reach the balloon hang from its underside or cling to its sides, touching it; any that drop off fall back to the table.
pc.fail: Scraps hover in the air between table and balloon without touching either; or a scrap that lets go drifts upward or sideways; or scraps rise past the balloon and continue upward; or scraps on the balloon's top stand upright away from it.

pc.expect: The balloon is a light elastic shell that keeps its round shape; the scraps are limp paper that bend and flutter.
pc.fail: The balloon keeps a deep dent after the hand leaves; or stretches out like taffy; or the scraps stand rigid like cards on the balloon; or the scraps stretch.

pc.expect: Each scrap moves along the line from its spot to the balloon and stops on the balloon; scraps travel with the balloon as it is moved.
pc.fail: A scrap flies past the balloon and off; or scraps circle the balloon in the air; or scraps stay hanging in place when the balloon is moved away; or scraps bounce off the balloon and back again several times.

pc.expect: The scraps on the balloon are the scraps from the table; the balloon stays one balloon and passes through nothing.
pc.fail: Scraps multiply on the balloon; or scraps vanish in mid-air; or the balloon passes into the table; or scraps merge into one sheet.

pc.expect: The balloon's colour, the scraps' colour and the table surface stay the same.
pc.fail: The balloon changes colour or size; or the scraps change colour; or the table changes pattern.
